meta.title: Treasury Bond Auction Calendar | Midway Securities Ltd.
meta.description: Monthly Treasury Bond auction dates, amounts, last cut-off yields and how to apply through Midway Securities Ltd.

header.headline: Treasury Bond Auction Calendar
header.subhead: This month's Bangladesh Bank auction dates and amounts, plus last month's results, all in one place.

howToApply.title: How to Apply Through Midway
steps: Open the Midway Portal and choose Government Bonds.
Apply by 11:00 AM on Sunday. Minimum ৳1 lakh.
Your bonds are credited to your BO Account about a week after a successful auction.
howToApply.note: Charges are shared when you contact us on WhatsApp.

reissueNote.title: What Reissue Means
reissueNote.body: Bangladesh Bank is currently selling more of bonds it has already issued. The coupon and maturity date stay the same, so the time left is shorter than the original term. The Tenor column groups each bond by about how many years it has left. Your yield depends on the price you pay at the auction.

afterYouBuy.title: After You Buy, There Is Nothing to Do

items.title: Interest Every 6 Months
items.body: Bangladesh Bank deposits it directly into your bank account.

items.title: Principal at Maturity
items.body: Bangladesh Bank deposits it into your bank account when the bond matures.

items.title: 10% AIT
items.body: AIT is deducted by Bangladesh Bank from every interest payment.

bills.title: Treasury Bill Auction Results
bills.note: Treasury Bills cannot be bought through brokerage houses. Government Sukuk primary auctions are not available through brokerage houses either. We show bill results so you can see the full market.

items.def: About how many years are left until the bond matures. Bangladesh Bank groups reissued bonds this way.
The day Bangladesh Bank holds the auction.
The date the bond was first issued.
More of an existing bond sold again, with the same coupon and maturity date as the original.
The fixed yearly interest rate paid on the bond's face value.
The highest yield Bangladesh Bank accepted at the auction. Bids above it were rejected.

cta.title: Ready to Apply for the Next Auction?
cta.body: Apply in the Midway Portal, or message us on WhatsApp with any question.

disclaimer: Information is from Bangladesh Bank auction notices and is provided for general guidance only. Bond yields and prices change with each auction and past results do not indicate future results. Returns are not guaranteed. Consider whether an investment suits your circumstances and seek professional advice if needed.
